component.name: StreamToggles
component.summary: Macro pad and toggle controller for Linux desktop streaming setups

ul.li: Pure Qt 6 and PyQt6 interface strictly adhering to modern KDE Plasma HIG
Visual canvas sections for grouping controls into distinct visual grids
Single, double, toggle, and command action types
Mutually exclusive button groups (radio button behavior)
Global keyboard shortcuts across Wayland, KDE Plasma, and Linux desktops via XDG Desktop Portal
Non-blocking background execution for HTTP requests and shell scripts

description.p: Converted to Qt 6 and modern KDE Plasma application architecture.
